2608.27454.title: WikiSkill: Compiling Agent Experience into Persistent Knowledge for Skill Evolution
2608.27454.paper_summary: Agent skills package specialized knowledge and workflows into reusable resources that extend AI agent capabilities. Recent work automatically discovers such skills from agent experience, which enables agents to progressively adapt through interaction. However, the insights that guide skill development typically remain scattered across optimization histories, limiting their systematic reuse across iterations. We introduce WikiSkill, a framework that co-evolves agent skills with a persistent knowledge base (wiki). At a high level, WikiSkill separates raw execution experience, accumulated knowledge, and executable skills, while continuously consolidating experience into the wiki, which subsequent skill updates can build on. Across diverse benchmarks and models, WikiSkill consistently outperforms state-of-the-art skill-evolution methods and improves over no-skill baselines in most model-benchmark settings. We find that skill evolution complements model scaling: larger models generally benefit more from evolved skills, while smaller models with skills can outperform substantially larger models without them. We also find that evolved skills transfer effectively across models and model families, and skills evolved by other models can outperform self-evolved skills. Finally, our ablation studies confirm that persistent knowledge accumulation in the wiki is critical for effective skill evolution. These results demonstrate the benefits of systematically accumulating and refining agent experience for developing reusable and transferable skills.
2608.27454.paper_summary_zh: 代理技能包將專業知識和工作流程整合為可重用的資源，以擴展 AI 代理的能力。最近的研究自動從代理經驗中發現這些技能，使代理能夠通過互動逐步適應。然而，指導技能發展的見解通常散佈在優化歷史中，限制了它們在迭代中的系統性重用。我們介紹了 WikiSkill，一個與持久知識庫（wiki）共同演化代理技能的框架。在高層次上，WikiSkill 將原始執行經驗、累積知識和可執行技能分開，同時不斷將經驗整合到 wiki 中，以便後續的技能更新可以在其上構建。在多種基準和模型中，WikiSkill 一直超越最先進的技能演化方法，並在大多數模型-基準設置中改善了無技能基線。我們發現技能演化與模型擴展相輔相成：較大的模型通常從演化的技能中受益更多，而擁有技能的小型模型可以顯著超越沒有技能的更大型模型。我們還發現演化的技能能有效地在模型和模型家族之間轉移，其他模型演化的技能可以超越自我演化的技能。最後，我們的消融研究確認，wiki 中持久的知識積累對於有效的技能演化至關重要。這些結果展示了系統性積累和精煉代理經驗以發展可重用和可轉移技能的好處。
